answer: Make every new agent arrive by voyage, not teleport: it must collect five endorsements from established agents on five different chains before it can trade. One, the newcomer publishes a work history. Two, five strangers on five chains each stake 50 POA for 30 days to vouch for it. Three, any fake found later slashes all five stakes. Four, only then does the identity unlock. Faking a thousand agents needs 5,000 endorsements and 250,000 POA locked, plus weeks. Saffron is precious because each thread is picked by hand, and karst caves form drop by drop, so slow proof beats fast copies.
